findings.problem: Development cells marked VIFS1-first still fall back to the block table on VIFS1 miss, and the aarch64 image verifier does not require periph-demo, so stale removable-media periph-demo can still execute.
findings.fix: Fail closed for development-cell VIFS1 misses or require all three VIFS1-first demos in the packaging verifier.
findings.rollback: Remove the demos from EMBEDDED_DEVELOPMENT_CELLS until the packaging gate is fail-closed; hardware evidence collected through fallback cannot be made authoritative after the fact.

findings.problem: The RPi3 BCM GPIO success path returns before UART and spawn-pinned sentinel coverage, and the retained hardware transcript lacks those markers.
findings.fix: Continue through the UART and spawn-pinned regressions after the BCM GPIO gate, or split the BCM gate into a dedicated cell.
findings.rollback: Remove the early return after a handled BCM GPIO gate; no irreversible external state.

findings.problem: A partial arm/toggle failure can leave the BCM GPIO interrupt enabled or uncleared for later cells.
findings.fix: Add a cleanup path or guard after partial IRQ arm attempts.

positives.summary: MMIO denial logging captures enough context to debug capability/range mismatches without changing the syscall result contract.
The pinned-worker argv sentinel bounds the self-spawn path when that code is reached.

incomplete_checks: WSL-native Cargo unavailable: cargo command not found
Hardware transcript does not contain UART or pinned-worker markers after periph-demo
